prophets_amulet.desc: The Prophet's Amulet pulses with carved foresight — WIS rises by 2 permanently.

aesops_quill.desc: Aesop's Quill carries a slave's earned freedom — WIS rises by 1 permanently.

lyre_of_orpheus.desc: Orpheus's lyre paused rivers and charmed Cerberus — buffs from it last 10 turns longer.

tablet_of_gilgamesh.desc: The Tablet of Gilgamesh holds the oldest epic — INT rises by 1 permanently.

scales_of_maat.desc: The Scales of Ma'at weigh every heart against truth — WIS rises by 1 permanently.

tablet_of_hammurabi.desc: Hammurabi's tablet replaced chaos with written law — INT rises by 2 permanently.

torc_of_boudicca.desc: Boudicca's Torc fights fiercest when surrounded — STR rises by 2 permanently.

rands_heart.desc: Rand's Heart carries a lover's promise to Robyn — buffs from it last 6 turns longer.

dreamspun_sketchbook.desc: The Dreamspun Sketchbook brought dreams to life — INT rises by 2 permanently.

charmander_stuffie.desc: The Charmander Stuffie is a child's oldest friend, full of love — CON rises by 2 permanently.

jade_cicada.desc: The Han buried jade cicadas with their dead to guarantee resurrection — the cicada now restores its bearer to full HP on resurrection.

seal_of_solomon.desc: Michael gave Solomon the Seal engraved with the true name of God — WIS rises by 2 permanently.

kavacha_kundala.desc: Karna was born wearing Kavacha and Kundala fused to his skin — CON rises by 2 permanently.

circes_wand.desc: Circe's Wand turned crews to swine on Aeaea — it gains 2 extra charges on mastery.

indras_vajra.desc: Indra's Vajra struck Vritra and freed the seven rivers — it gains 3 extra charges on mastery.

book_of_thoth.desc: Thoth's book identifies what was hidden — the next reading of the Book of Thoth does not consume the scroll.

sefer_yetzirah.desc: The Sefer Yetzirah teaches the twenty-two letters that spoke the world into being — its spell costs 2 fewer MP.

picatrix.desc: Picatrix systematised four centuries of talismanic magic — its spell costs 2 fewer MP.

lemegeton.desc: The Lemegeton names all seventy-two demons of Solomon — its spell costs 3 fewer MP.
